title: The Enchiridion
summary: A short handbook of the former slave turned Stoic teacher Epictetus: some things are up to us (opinions, choices, desires) and others are not (body, reputation, money); we suffer when we confuse the two. Treat life like a play where you act your role well, want things to happen as they happen, and judge yourself, not others.
